evals.name: robotics-dark-technical
evals.prompt: build me a landing page for my robotics startup. we make autonomous warehouse picking arms and we sell to logistics companies. it needs to feel serious and technical, not startup-cute. dark. implement at least the nav, hero and one content section with real copy.
evals.expected_output: A Next.js project matched to a dark technical reference, with a real design token system, section variety, and copy about warehouse robotics.
assertions: Project is structurally complete (package.json, app/layout.tsx, app/page.tsx)
Colour lives in a central token system rather than scattered through components
Ships real copy with no placeholder text
Adjacent sections differ (not identical stacked slabs)
